notes.title: V2.01 - Bug Fixes, Speedrun Update, Weapon Skins Support
notes.content:
In this small update a few bugs were fixed:
- getting stuck in levels with many rocks on the ground
- Speedrun Logic was reworked and fixed
- Pause Functionality broke the game when pausing the game after dying

Additionally users are now able to purchase DLCs to upgrade their visuals. Two rifle skins are either unlockable by playing the game to a higher level or by purchasing it in the store.

notes.title: V1.4 Final Performance Update & Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This update will be the final big performance update since every single considerable optimization method was used to reduce the frame cost. The game will even be playable on lower hardware than declared in the minimum requirements.

In order to keep your GPU not rendering as fast as possible the "Max Frame Rate" option was set to 60. If you set this to endless your GPU will try to produce as many frames as possible and this may be resulting in louder ventilation.

If there are critical bugs, please don't hesitate to reach out in one of the Discussion Forums here on Steam or in the Discord Channel! Thank you all!

tags.bug: - If there are critical bugs, please don't hesitate to reach out in one of the Discussion Forums here on Steam or in the Discord Channel! Thank you all!

notes.title: V 1.22 Massive Performance Update 3 & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Performance:
- reduces material cost
- optimized rain effects
- optimized Lumen & shadows
- implemented "Max FPS" setting to not force your PC to render max possible FPS
- reduced post processing effects

Bugs:
- Speedrun Lock-Puzzle forcing players back to the main menu
- reduced getting stuck in rocks
- simplified puzzles a little at the start of the game
- removed some invisible walls or exchanged them with meshes

I really hope the game now works on all computers who have the minimum declared hardware on the shop-page! I would love you to show me the effect with positive reviews! <3

Any future bugs can be reported on the Discord Server or via the steam community tab!
